Tania Sturton and Catherine Eastham held the team steady in a medal winning position as team fortunes around them chopped and changed. South London Harriers had made a winning strike and were now being followed by Ranelagh Harriers.

Not one of our better results, writes Catherine Eastham, with a number of key senior athletes missing and the limited number of juniors still affecting the points.

Team Manager Catherine Eastham put her clipboard and team sheet aside to keep the Belles in the hunt and with Jules surging through on the last stage we came home fourth – and third in the Surrey Championship as Epsom’s outstanding Emily Nelson had run twice in her club’s team, thus ruling them ineligible.
The most important cog is imperiously in place, as in Catherine Eastham the women boast a team manager every bit as inspirational, thorough and determined as what the men enjoy.
